task.title: How to set up a print server
task.shortdesc: The objective of a print server is to streamline and optimize printing tasks throughout the network. The print server works as an intermediary between client computers and printers, handling print jobs and ensuring efficient print management.

prereq.p: Ensure you have the following before starting:

ul.li: SNMP is enabled on the network.

step.cmd: Log in to the Windows Server 2019 or 2022 with administrative credentials.
Open the Server Manager and select 'Add roles and features'.
In the 'Add Roles and Features Wizard', select 'Print and Document Services' and click 'Next'.
Follow the prompts to complete the installation of the Print Server role.
Configure the print server settings as needed, including setting up printers and managing print queues.

note.p: If you encounter issues with SNMP or bi-directionality, refer to the Enable SNMP and Bi-directionality troubleshooting topics.
